sentences.text: This appeal under Section 173 of Motor Vehicles Act (for short " MV Act") has been filed challenging the award dated 16.09.2019 passed by the learned First Additional Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, Raipur (CG) in Claim Case No. 403/2015.

entities.text: First Additional Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, Raipur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: By the impugned award, the learned tribunal has awarded Rs.1,05,000/- as compensation to the appellants/claimants with 9% interest per annum on account of the injury sustained by the appellant in an accident which took place on 16.09.2019 by rash and negligent driving of respondent No.1/driver by offending vehicle i.e. Truck bearing Registration No. CG-08-B-1089, owned by respondent No.2/owner and insured with respondent No.3/insurance company.

2) A claim application under Section 166 of Motor Vehicle Act, 1988 (for short "MV Act") has been filed inter alia pleading that on the date of accident, the appellant suffered serious injuries,
sustained permanent disablement and spent huge amount on treatment, therefore, the claim application was filed.

3) Learned counsel appearing on behalf of appellants/claimant argued that the learned tribunal has committed an error of law in awarding less amount of compensation, the amount spent on treatment has not been done.

Apart from this, the amount on other heads in also on the lower side,
therefore, it may suitably be enhanced.
4) At the outset, learned counsel for respondent No. 3 submits that the present appeal is not maintainable as the injured/complainant has died during the pendency of the appeal.

Moreover,
learned counsel for respondent No. 3 supported the award and submits that looking to the evidence on record, the compensation has rightly been awarded and does not require any interference by this Court.

5) Learned Tribunal has awarded compensation as following heads:-
 Sl. Heads Compensation a  No. by the tri  1. For Treatment and Medical Bill Rs. 15  2. For Transportation, attendant Rs. 30  and Special diet

Total compensation Rs. 1,0 6) Considering the submission made by the learned counsel for the respondent that the injured/complainant has died on 22.08.2022, this Court is of the opinion that grivance raised in the present appeal is not sustainable for enhancement of compensation as the injured/complainant has died.
Moreover, looking to the evidence on record, the compensation has rightly been awarded and does not require any interference by this Court.
Therefore, the appeal fails and is dismissed.

opennyai_summary.facts:
This appeal under Section 173 of Motor Vehicles Act (for short " MV Act") has been filed challenging the award dated 16.09.2019 passed by the learned First Additional Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, Raipur (CG) in Claim Case No. 403/2015.
By the impugned award, the learned tribunal has awarded Rs.1,05,000/- as compensation to the appellants/claimants with 9% interest per annum on account of the injury sustained by the appellant in an accident which took place on 16.09.2019 by rash and negligent driving of respondent No.1/driver by offending vehicle i.e. Truck bearing Registration No. CG-08-B-1089, owned by respondent No.2/owner and insured with respondent No.3/insurance company.
2) A claim application under Section 166 of Motor Vehicle Act, 1988 (for short "MV Act") has been filed inter alia pleading that on the date of accident, the appellant suffered serious injuries,
sustained permanent disablement and spent huge amount on treatment, therefore, the claim application was filed.
opennyai_summary.arguments:
3) Learned counsel appearing on behalf of appellants/claimant argued that the learned tribunal has committed an error of law in awarding less amount of compensation, the amount spent on treatment has not been done.
Moreover,
learned counsel for respondent No. 3 supported the award and submits that looking to the evidence on record, the compensation has rightly been awarded and does not require any interference by this Court.
opennyai_summary.decision:
5) Learned Tribunal has awarded compensation as following heads:-
 Sl. Heads Compensation a  No. by the tri  1. For Treatment and Medical Bill Rs. 15  2. For Transportation, attendant Rs. 30  and Special diet
3 . For loss of income Rs. 30
4. For pain & suffer Rs. 30
Moreover, looking to the evidence on record, the compensation has rightly been awarded and does not require any interference by this Court.
Therefore, the appeal fails and is dismissed.
